data.name: Shadowstalk
data.detailed_description:
Deadly Tactics

Dive into action-packed battles where split-second decisions can determine victory or defeat.

Shadowstalk combines stealth and real-time tactics, forcing you to adapt quickly, outmaneuver your enemies, and strike at the perfect moment.

Each match unfolds across three fast-paced rounds, where strategy and timing determine who survives.

Will you dominate the battlefield - or fall to the shadows?

Unique Survivors and Exceptional Abilities

Whether you prefer to fool your opponents with Kage no Akuma, poison your rivals with Lila The Nightfall or brute force your path to victory with Claw of Incas, you'll find a fighter to match your playstyle.

Master each fighter's special abilities and craft your own strategies to lead you to victory.

Explore Diverse Locations

Fight across meticulously crafted maps and explore the spiritual hometown of each contestant.

Travel across legendary locations such as Peru and Egypt, each offering unique terrain, hiding spots, and tactical opportunities.

Take on players worldwide in thrilling PvP matches

Shadowstalk's Shadow Arena features free-for-all battles with up to 4 players where each one fights for their own glory.

Can you rely on your own skill when survival is on the line, or will you watch from the shadows as death comes for each of you?

Become the Ultimate Survivor

The battlefield is unforgiving, but victory is incredibly rewarding

Crush your enemies
Outsmart their strategies
Strike when they least expect it

Enter the shadows and prove your dominance!

Join the fight now!

With regular updates, new legends and locations, the world of Shadowstalk is constantly evolving!

data.short_description: Shadowstalk is a top-down multiplayer stealth tactics game. Play as a mythological legend summoned into a high-stakes Death Game. Harness the power of shadows, outsmart your rivals with unique abilities, and fight to be the last survivor in intense real-time tactical battles.

English*, French, Italian, German, Portuguese - Portugal, Arabic

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-4160 or AMD Athlon X4 740
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidia GT 730 or AMD Radeon R7 430
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 4 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 11 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-11600 or AMD Ryzen 5 3600X
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidia GTX 1050 or AMD Radeon RX 460
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 4 GB available space

linux_requirements.minimum:

  • Processor: Intel Core i3-4160 or AMD Athlon X4 740
  • Memory: 6 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidia GTX 560 or Radeon HD 5850
  • Storage: 4 GB available space
